summary: Beta Bionics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing FDA clearance of Mint, its patch pump, and submission of a 510(k) for its 3D Intelligence insulin dosing algorithm. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor is stated. Commercial launch is expected in Q1 2027 via the pharmacy channel, with capacity for at least 1.5 million disposable units in 2027 and coverage anticipated for roughly 40% of insured U.S. lives initially, rising above 50%. This is a routine product-regulatory disclosure; there is no deal or risk-arb angle.
